failure.title: Direct check-in navigation redirected before client selection restoration completed
failure.note: The direct /check-in production-web journey retained a trace and error context after a previously selected synthetic client was redirected to the selector before its persisted selection restored.
failure.diagnosis: SelectionProvider was still loading AsyncStorage when CheckInRoute evaluated a transient null client ID as final and redirected. The surrounding tabs layout handled restoration correctly, but the route failed to distinguish loading from no selection.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
